result:
The fix for this is ticket **O3-4518**, and the change is a switch from loading one page of users to server-side user search in the stock user role scope workspace. I could not confirm the REST default page size or find the commit or PR that made the change, so those parts are unverified.

**Why the users were missing:** The workspace's own comment says the change "fixes O3-4518: systems with many users" (`add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx:93`). The current code requests users through `useSearchUser`, which calls `/user` with `limit: 10` and a `q` search string. A user only appears if they match what the admin types, so no account is stranded outside a single fixed first response. I did not find the earlier version of this code, so I can't show exactly how the old list was built. My inference is that it fetched one default page and never paged past it. The "about 50 per response" figure is also unverified: my searches of openmrs-core for a default page size found nothing.

**Evidence, best first:**
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-user-role-scopes/add-stock-user-scope/add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx` lines 93–112: the O3-4518 comment, the server-side search hook, the debounced search, and the filtered user list.
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-operations/stock-operations-forms/hooks/useSearchUser.ts` lines 9–45: `limit: 10`, `startIndex: 0`, and `q: searchString` passed to `useUsers`.
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-lookups/stock-lookups.resource.ts` lines 150–164: `useUsers` builds the `/user` request from the filter criteria.
